content: Chromium mac: web_input_event_builders_mac.mm sets force=[event pressure], tilt_x=tilt.x*90, tilt_y=(isFlipped?1:-1)*tilt.y*90, tangential_pressure, twist=rotation mod 360 for NSEventSubtypeTabletPoint; render_widget_host_view_cocoa.mm sets _pointerType kEraser when pointingDeviceType==NSPointingDeviceTypeEraser on tablet proximity; blink pointer_event_factory.cc maps kEraser to pointerType 'pen' and sets buttons |= kEraser (32) and clears kLeft when buttons!=0.
